title: The Real Estate Market Is Dead in Spain. Long Live Bitcoin.
summary: Bitcoin Magazine The Real Estate Market Is Dead in Spain. Long Live Bitcoin. A 2% rent ceiling against 4.9% September inflation, plus compulsory five- and seven-year renewals, rewrites signed leases. The Bank of Spain still puts the housing deficit near 750,000 homes. This post The Real Estate Market Is Dead in Spain. Long Live Bitcoin. first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Kristyna Mazankova .
